subject: mathematics
title: Equivalent Fractions — Practice Set 2
description: A second timed set focused on missing values, simplification, and equivalence checks.

questions.question: Which fraction is equivalent to 2/3?
questions.hint: Compare by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number.

options.feedback: 4/9 is not equal to 2/3; cross-products are 12 and 18.
6/9 simplifies to 2/3 by dividing numerator and denominator by 3.
8/15 does not equal 2/3; cross-products are 24 and 30.
10/12 simplifies to 5/6, not 2/3.

questions.question: Complete the equivalent fraction: 3/5 = ?/20
questions.hint: Find the factor that changes 5 into 20, then use the same factor on 3.

options.feedback: 8/20 simplifies to 2/5.
10/20 simplifies to 1/2.
The denominator is multiplied by 4, so 3×4 = 12.
15/20 simplifies to 3/4.

questions.question: Which fraction is NOT equivalent to 3/4?
questions.hint: Reduce each fraction or compare cross-products with 3/4.

options.feedback: 6/8 reduces to 3/4.
9/12 reduces to 3/4.
12/16 reduces to 3/4.
15/24 reduces to 5/8, so it is not equivalent to 3/4.

questions.explanation: 15/24 simplifies to 5/8, while the other three fractions simplify to 3/4.

questions.question: What is 18/24 in simplest form?
questions.hint: Divide numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

options.feedback: 18/24 does not reduce to 2/3; 18×3 = 54 while 24×2 = 48.
Dividing both 18 and 24 by 6 gives 3/4.
6/8 is equivalent but is not in simplest form.
9/12 is equivalent but is not in simplest form.

questions.explanation: The greatest common factor of 18 and 24 is 6, so 18/24 = 3/4.

questions.question: Are 4/7 and 12/21 equivalent?
questions.hint: Check whether the same multiplier changes both numerator and denominator.

options.text: Yes, because both parts are multiplied by 3
options.feedback: 4×3 = 12 and 7×3 = 21, so the fractions are equivalent.

options.text: Yes, because both parts are multiplied by 4
options.feedback: Multiplying 4/7 by 4 gives 16/28, not 12/21.

options.text: No, because the numerators are different
options.feedback: Equivalent fractions can have different numerators.
Equivalent fractions may use larger numerator and denominator values while representing the same value.

questions.explanation: 4/7 and 12/21 are equivalent because numerator and denominator are both multiplied by 3.
